description: Request cancellation of a background job started with submitCall. This is a REQUEST, not a guarantee: a live executor receives an abort locally or observes a persisted request within its lease check. A remote response means requested, not stopped. A genuine terminal result wins if work completes despite cancellation. Foreign/unknown ids do not confirm job existence. Free: does not call an AI provider. Cancellation does not guarantee no charges and does not undo completed work.
name: cancelCall
